name: MOTOR OIL (HELL.) EO 0,75
summary: MOTOR OIL (HELL.) EO 0,75 is a Greek oil refining company involved in the refining and marketing of petroleum products. The company operates a refinery in Corinth, Greece, and distributes fuels and lubricants through a network of service stations and other channels. Motor Oil also has interests in renewable energy and natural gas.
